annotations.title: Find agent skills and MCP servers for game dev

description: Find agent skills and MCP servers for game development listed on QuickMatch, filtered by kind, coding agent, engine and words. Returns up to 10 with agents, engines, license, cost, last update and a quickmatch.si link.

engine.description: Engine or tool, matched the same way ("godot" matches "Godot 4.7+"). Values in the list: aseprite, babylon-js, bethesda, bevy, blender, blockbench, cocos-creator, effekseer, engine-agnostic, flame, gamemaker, godot, higgsfield-web-game-template, littlejs, love, maya, melonjs, minecraft, net-xna, p, phaser, pixijs, playcanvas, pygame, roblox, shadertoy, source, spine, three-js, three-js-r, unity, unreal-engine, web, webgl, webgpu, zbrush.
